name: CCRent
tagline: Your own overseas Mac mini, with Claude Code ready to go
description: CCRent rents dedicated Mac mini M4 machines hosted overseas (North America, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia) on residential broadband with their own IP. Claude Desktop, Claude Code and dev tools come preinstalled, with a Claude Max 5x or 20x plan active. Connect remotely and start coding. CCRent is an independent provider, not affiliated with Anthropic.
